title: The Parish of Ashcombe
author: Zephyrine Nakamura
blurb: Ivo Galloway, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
